one_liner.zh: 为 OpenCode 请求补上稳定的会话标识请求头
one_liner.en: Adds a stable per-conversation session header to OpenCode requests.

local: DSH outbound model calls must use globalThis.fetch

config_items.name: providers
config_items.description: Provider route keys receiving the header; defaults to OpenCode routes.

config_items.name: mode
config_items.description: Use DSH session id or a per-session UUID as header value.

config_items.name: debug
config_items.description: Log streamed requests that receive the header.

config_items.name: debugFile
config_items.description: Append one JSON debug record per streamed request to a file.

completeness.reason: Handles provider/session filtering, stable values, existing headers, streaming context and cleanup; model listing is outside the hook.

code.reason: Small ESM implementation separates configuration, session value derivation, stream context and fetch patching with cleanup.

docs.reason: README explains installation, configuration, behavior and limitations with examples.
